findings.title: The output already labels the amount as an estimate and preserves separate obligation facts
findings.assessment: payment_estimate_eur is expressly an estimate rather than an unconditional payable label. Participation, contract establishment/current year, access consequence, current exit, annual claim, control refusal and assigned exclusion are genuine amount gates; area and content reductions and modulation are calculated. The output also preserves obligation_breaches. These improvements are credited. Separate source/authority/evidence states and disclosed A11/A12 cap/reduction scope still qualify the estimate. This informational boundary alone is not a new agricultural counterexample or a claim that every local diagnosis demands100percent reduction.
findings.impact: Use the amount with evidence, current lifecycle and authority assessment. General owns concrete missing cap/reduction-order/lifecycle consumers and Domain owns actual local ban/order/exit countercases. No invented universal zero-payment oracle or actual payment authorization is inferred.
